english.title: Cause failure to keep documentation and declaration of conformity re: energy related product
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused

(A)_[a manufacturer, namely **(..SPECIFY MANUFACTURER..),]_
(B)_[an authorised representative, namely **(..SPECIFY REPRESENTATIVE..),]_
(C)_[an importer, namely **(..SPECIFY IMPORTER..),]_

who had

(D)_[placed on the market]_
(E)_[put into service]_

an energy-related product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), to fail to keep

(F)_[documentation relevant to the conformity assessment procedure]_
(G)_[every declaration of conformity]_
(H)_[documentation relevant to the conformity assessment procedure and every declaration of conformity]_

available for inspection by the market surveillance authority for at least 10 years from **(..SPECIFY DATE OF LAST MANUFACTURE..), being the date the product was last manufactured and make it available within 10 days of a request by that authority
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9 and 14 of the Ecodesign for Energy-Related Products Regulations 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused a manufacturer / authorised representative / importer
who had placed on market / put into service an energy related product
to fail to keep documentation relevant to the conformity assessment procedure / every declaration of conformity
available for inspection by the market surveillance authority for at least 10 years from date of last manufacture
and make it available within 10 days of a request

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 12 of the Ecodesign for Energy-RelatedProducts Regulations 2010 provides that the market surveillance authority may authorise in writing such personswho appear suitable to act on its behalf to carry out any functions and toexercise any power conferred by RAMS, subject to any limitations or conditionsas it sees fit.
(ii) Regulation 19 of the Ecodesign for Energy-RelatedProducts Regulations 2010 provides that the court may (in addition to any other order it may make as to costs orexpenses) order the person convicted to reimburse the market surveillanceauthority for any expenditure which it or any authorised person has reasonablyincurred in investigating the offence, including in purchasing or in testing orexamining any energy-related product, or any part of it, in respect of whichthe offence was committed.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutorymaximum.
Indictment: A fine.
